facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications issued a rule in November 2017 requiring public cloud computing operators to build infrastructure in Algeria and host and store data locally.
The same cloud localisation rule was issued by the Regulatory Authority of Post and Electronic Communications, which licenses cloud data hosting providers, per Digital Policy Alert.
Digital Policy Alert says the Law on Audiovisual Activity entered into force in December 2024, requiring online audiovisual services to be hosted on servers physically located in Algeria.

Digital Policy Alert says the ANPDP, the National Data Protection Authority, oversees data protection compliance and in October 2024 signed a cooperation memorandum with Mauritius's Data Protection Authority.
Digital Policy Alert says Algeria implemented the Law Relating to the Protection of Individuals in the Processing of Personal Data in August 2023.

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the ANPDP oversees compliance with the law and signed a memorandum with Mauritius's authority in October 2024.

Digital Policy Alert says the 2023 personal data law allows transfers to states with adequate protection and with prior ANPDP authorisation, or on stated conditions such as explicit consent, and bars transfers endangering public security.
